signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.sub: Sign in to your brand or creator account.
signIn.demoBody: Open a demo account in one click. Each one already has collaborations, clicks and sign-ups in it, so you can see how it all works without signing up.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subBrand: Start with your account. Next, you paste your website and review what we take from it: your value proposition and your ideal customers.
signUp.subCreator: Start with your account. Next, you add your LinkedIn profile, build your card, set your price and fill in your legal details.
signUp.heardAbout: How did you hear about us?
signUp.demoHint: Just looking? Open a demo account from the sign-in page, no sign-up needed.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sub: Enter the email you signed up with. We'll send you a link to choose a new password. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
forgot.emailedBody: No email at {email}? Use this link.
forgot.notEmailedTitle: No email is sent in this build
forgot.notEmailedBody: Here's the link we'd have sent to {email}.
forgot.linkNote: The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
forgot.noAccountBody: No account uses {email}. Check the spelling, or create an account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.sub: At least 8 characters. You'll use it the next time you sign in.

reasons.missing: This isn't a link we made. Check that you copied all of it.
reasons.expired: This link has expired. Reset links last 30 minutes.
reasons.used: This link has already been used. Each one works once.
reasons.unconfigured: Password reset isn't available on this deployment: its database isn't configured.
reasons.unavailable: Password reset is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
